skill_name: Summarize the main points of Plato's republic.
workflow: Plato's Republic is a classical philosophical dialogue written in the 3rd century BCE. In the dialogue, Plato explores the concepts of justice and morality. He does this by presenting a state - known as the republic - in which justice is the paramount virtue.
